simple.meaning: properly, to miscarry , i.e. suffer abortion ; by analogy, to bereave (literally or figuratively)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to שָׁכֹל (H7921) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 24 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: שָׁכֹל (shâkôl) means properly, to miscarry , i.e. suffer abortion ; by analogy, to bereave (literally or figuratively) First listed occurrence: 1Sam 15 33.

definitions.full: H7921. shakol or shakal [ שָׁכַל שָׁכֹל, Lag BN 26 ] verb be bereaved (= Arabic תְּכֵל תְּכוֺל, ᵑ7 ; compare Syriac loss of children ); — Qal Perfect 1singular שָׁכָ֑לְתִּי שָׁכֹלְתִּי כַּאֲשֶׁר Gen 43:14 (E) if I am bereaved, I am bereaved (of father, expressing resignation; on כָ֑לְ see Ges § 29u ); Imperfect 1singular אֶשְׁכַּל 27:45 (E), with accusative of person be bereaved of you both (of mother); 3 feminine singular אִמֶּ֑ךָ מִנָּשִׁים תִּשְׁכַּל 1Sam 15:33 thy mother shall be bereaved above (more than) women . Pi`el Perfect 3feminine singular שִׁכְּלָה 1Sam 15:33 +, suffix וְשִׁכְּלָ֑תָּה Ezek 14:15 , etc.; Imperfect 3feminine singular תְּשַׁכֵּל Deut 32:25 +, 2 feminine singular תְּשַׁכְּלִי Ezek 36:14 Qr (see כָּשַׁל Pi`el ); Infinitive construct suffix לְשַׁכְּלָם Ezek 36:12 ; Participle מְשַׁכֵּלָה Exod 23:26 , כֶּ֫לֶת - Ezek 36:13 , כָּ֫לֶת +? 2Kin 2:19 , 21 ; — 1 make childless , accusative of father Gen 42:36 (E), of mothers 1Sam 15:33 (subject חֶרֶב ), compare Ezek 5:17 (subject famine and beasts), and 14:15 ( id. ; object land); accusative of people Hosea 9:12 ( מֵאָדָם ), Jer 15:7 (+ אִבַּתְִּי ), Ezek 36:12 , compare 36:13 ; 36:14 (see above); object omitted (subject חֶרֶב ) Deut 22:25 ; Lam 1:20 ; Ezek 21:19 (Co, for תִּכָּפֵל , see כָּפַל ; otherwise Toy Krae). 2. a. cause barrenness , or abortion, מְשַׁכְּ ׳הָאָרֶץ 2Kin 2:19 , compare 2:21 (Thes otherwise, see ׳מְשׁ infra). b. shew barrenness , or abortion , (1) of any female Exod 23:26 (E; + עֲקָרָה ), animals Gen 31:38 (E) Job 21:10 ; (2) of vine Mal 3:11 .
